column8: The idea of refining the search was quite useful, but I had to figure out what kind of clue to add next.
column9: I would add smarter follow up questions when the results aren't relevant. So the AI can help me describe what I remember instead of making me figure out the right search words myself

column8: The UI is overwhelming, the button 'Not this photo' gives error. Only first tab 'AI memory assistant' is useful for users. The workflow can be better and simpler. The dataset of 40 images feels small to actual test the application. Tags/grouping/keywords could be more, e.g if I'm searching for Mounting, the synonyms or related words could have been applied like Hill, Rock, Nature etc.
column9: I like the additional clue feature which adds data over the top of old query which does not override the old data. This will help to deepen the search. I'd keep the UI as simple and minimal with easy to understand language for everyone.
